name: One&Only Aesthesis
insider_take: This ultra-luxe beachfront sanctuary sits on the coveted Athenian Riviera, where ancient mythology meets modern sophistication just 30 minutes from the Acropolis.
whats_special: One&Only Aesthesis occupies a prime spot on Astir Beach in Vouliagmeni, the same exclusive peninsula where Aristotle Onassis once entertained celebrities. The resort features direct access to crystal-clear Aegean waters and sits within the protected Vouliagmeni microclimate, known for its healing thermal springs and year-round pleasant temperatures.
pro_tip: Book a treatment at the Guerlain Spa and don't miss the nearby Lake Vouliagmeni - a natural thermal spa lake with constant 70°F waters that's been attracting wellness seekers since ancient times.
dont_miss: The sunset views from Nama restaurant are legendary, and the hotel's private beach club offers some of the most exclusive Mediterranean coastline access in Greece. Take the complimentary yacht shuttle to explore hidden coves along the Apollo Coast, or venture to the Temple of Poseidon at nearby Cape Sounion for breathtaking clifftop sunset views.
pros: Ultra-luxury beachfront resort with pristine Riviera coastline access
World-class spa and wellness facilities with innovative treatments
Exceptional fine dining with multiple acclaimed restaurants
Personalized butler service and exclusive One&Only hospitality standards
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Limited nearby local attractions outside resort grounds
